Before we begin

Common project questions.

What information helps you assess a project?

A short scope, site location, drawings or BOQ, target timeline and the operating constraint are the best starting point. We can then identify the right survey and technical inputs.

Can TechVantage handle supply and installation together?

Yes. Our delivery model can coordinate equipment and material sourcing, installation, testing, balancing, commissioning and handover under one scope.

Do you work only with pharmaceutical facilities?

No. Pharmaceutical and controlled environments are a core strength, while the same HVAC, MEP, ventilation and process-cooling capabilities also serve industrial, healthcare, laboratory, warehouse and commercial facilities.
